description: inference.metered, sold per call by Taifoon at 0.001 USDC (x402). Answered by Taifoon itself. Code checks the answer before you are charged. Without payment the tool returns the wall's x402 terms and what is behind it; with payment (the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE your wallet signed for those terms) it returns the answer and the sale.

input.description: the class input, e.g. {"model":"nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-BF16","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"What is 17 multiplied by 24? Show the calculation briefly."}],"max_tokens":128}

payment.description: optional: the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value (base64) for this wall's terms

name: taifoon_wall_inference_metered
